prerequisites: Basic knowledge of materials science as taught in the course "Introduction to Materials Science" (H01D0A)
Basic knowledge of quantum mechanics as taught in the course "Quantum Mechanics" (H08U5A)

learning_outcomes.text: The student has knowledge of the basic concepts of the structure and properties of crystalline solids.
The student knows the specific theoretical and experimental characteristics of insulators, semiconductors, and metals.
The student knows the methods by which the most commonly used materials in microelectronics are produced, characterized, and applied in practice.
The student has knowledge of various aspects of changing material properties by purposefully altering structure and chemical composition.
At the end of the course, the student is able to assess and understand the importance and challenge of materials research for microelectronics.

syllabus_topics: Crystal structure and the reciprocal lattice
Electrons in an atom and in a crystal
assessment_rules: The assessment consists of an oral examination with written preparation. The evaluation characteristics and determination of the final result for the resit opportunity are identical to those of the first examination opportunity.
institution: KU Leuven - Faculty of Engineering Science
degree: Bachelor in de ingenieurswetenschappen (Bachelor of Engineering Science, Leuven)
